prompt: Create a high-quality cinematic vertical smartphone selfie photo of a handsome young South Asian man sitting cross-legged on lush green grass beside a calm adult male lion. The man has thick black hair, a neatly trimmed full beard, warm medium skin tone, natural skin texture, and a relaxed friendly smile while looking directly into the camera. He wears a pristine white traditional South Asian shalwar kameez with a matching tailored blazer and black dress shoes. His left arm extends forward as if holding the phone for a selfie, and his right hand rests gently on the lion’s mane. The lion lies close beside him, facing the camera with a majestic golden mane, detailed fur, large paws, and a calm dignified expression. Set the scene in a sunny garden or wildlife park with scattered pale flower petals on the grass, soft greenery, trees, hedges, a fence, and a few blurred people in the background. Use shallow depth of field, natural golden-hour daylight, realistic colors, crisp facial details, cinematic bokeh, and an authentic mobile portrait composition. Keep exactly two main subjects: one man and one lion. No text, no watermark, no extra animals, no distorted hands, no artificial plastic skin.

promptZh: 创作一张高质量的电影感竖屏手机自拍照片，画面中一位 英俊的南亚年轻男子 正盘腿坐在郁郁葱葱的草地上，身旁是一头温顺的成年雄狮。男子留着浓密的黑发和修剪整齐的络腮胡，肤色呈温暖的小麦色，皮肤纹理自然，对着镜头露出轻松友好的微笑。他身着一套纯净的 白色 南亚传统沙尔瓦卡米兹（shalwar kameez），搭配剪裁合身的西装外套和黑色皮鞋。他的左臂向前伸展，仿佛正在用手机自拍，右手轻轻搭在狮子的鬃毛上。狮子紧挨着他卧在身旁，面对镜头，拥有雄伟的金色鬃毛、细腻的皮毛、巨大的爪子和冷静庄严的神态。场景设定在阳光明媚的花园或野生动物园中，草地上散落着淡色的花瓣，背景有柔和的绿植、树木、树篱、围栏以及几个模糊的人影。采用浅景深、自然的黄金时段日光、逼真的色彩、清晰的面部细节、电影级虚化效果以及真实的手机人像构图。画面中仅保留两个主体：一名男子和一头狮子。无文字，无水印，无额外动物，无扭曲的手部，无人工塑料感皮肤。
